answer: Because your offer was issued before February 1, 2026, it keeps the original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, rather than the newer 5-day limit. Your exact expiration date is shown on your offer page and in your confirmation email. If your February 4 appraisal appointment is on or before that date and you haven't driven more than 300 additional miles, we'll honor your offer. If it has expired, you can request a new offer at any time, though the amount may be higher or lower based on current market prices.
